response.text: That last query returned too many rows. The remaining checks cover the single anomalies, the GL journals, and how AP journals link to invoices and payments.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'bad_acct' k, l."JRNL_NO"::text a, '['||l."ACCT_CD"||']' b, l."DR_AMT"::text c, l."CR_AMT"::text d FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ne_inv', p."PAY_ID"::text, p."INV_ID"::text, p."PAY_AMT"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'outside_period', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, coalesce(h."MEMO",'') FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
SELECT "JRNL_NO","PRD_ID","POST_DT","SRC_REF","MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' ORDER BY "JRNL_NO" LIMIT 40

SELECT h."SRC_CD", count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN h."SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) payref, sum(CASE WHEN h."MEMO" LIKE 'Invoice%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) invmemo, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) is_inv_jrnl, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE 'PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"=h."SRC_REF") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_match FROM "GLJRNH" h GROUP BY 1
SELECT "JRNL_NO","SRC_REF","MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP' AND "SRC_REF" NOT LIKE 'PAY-%' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 5
